name: Every screen run leaves an append-only record of what it attempted — and a re-run under identical pins says so before it walks
notes: Verified live goal-desk-iter-29 by browser-qa-agent against the running rig (backend :8301 / frontend :3301) serving the REAL ambient apps/backend/.data store (never a scoped fixture). Prior to this iteration's run, the ambient Screen Runs ledger was genuinely empty (GET /research/desk/screen/runs -> {"runs":[],"latest":null,"integrity_errors":[]}) -- confirmed via DOM text extraction ('desk-screen-runs-empty' -> 'No screen runs recorded yet.') and used to verify the honest empty state (UT-01/UT-04). Clicking 'Run Screen' triggered a real fresh 101-member walk (started 2026-07-31T01:58:48.237928Z, finished 2026-07-31T02:00:29.056640Z, ~1m41s, screen_id screen-2026-07-31-c169546856c7, 100 ranked / 0 skipped no_bars / 1 skipped no_basis) -- confirmed via DOM text extraction + screenshot (UT-02, reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-29-evidence/UT-02-result.png). An immediate second click short-circuited via the five-pin reuse check: started/finished 2026-07-31T02:01:55.486557Z/2026-07-31T02:01:55.501036Z (~15ms, vs ~1m41s for the fresh walk, both timestamps read directly off GET /research/desk/screen/runs), reused=true, members_attempted 0/101, the SAME screen_id, table+latest-detail both rendering the honest 'reused <id> -- no walk was performed' text and honest zeroed counts (0 ranked / 0 skipped, NOT a fabricated re-count of the original walk's 100/0/1) -- confirmed via DOM text extraction + screenshot (UT-03, reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-29-evidence/UT-03-result.png).

This replay script is DELIBERATELY READ-ONLY (goto only, no click on 'Run Screen'), mirroring the J-09 precedent's own documented reasoning: the button triggers a real ~101-symbol walk against cached bar data whenever the day's five pins are new (e.g. a new UTC date), which would make every regression replay pay for (and depend on the timing of) a real compute rather than a deterministic assertion. Instead this script re-reads the two run records this session's real clicks already left durably on the ambient store's new screen_runs log -- the honest reused-outcome text is itself the assertion, exactly as J-09/J-17 assert the ambient store's own prior real run text rather than re-triggering a write.

Steps 2/3's expected text is the CURRENT ambient store's real latest-run stat line (screenrun-2026-07-31-0662273df270, the reused run left by this session's UT-03 click), not decorative chrome -- like J-09's topup text, this value is environment-dependent: if a further real 'Run Screen' click is ever recorded on the ambient store (a fresh walk on a new UTC date, or another duplicate-pin click), this step will need updating to that run's own stats (an honest environmental change, not a regression) -- see the J-09 script's own notes for the identical documented pattern.

Step 4 is a post-match liveness check (the iter-4/iter-5 lesson this project's other golden scripts also apply): a further /desk navigation AFTER the key text match, proving the page is still alive and rendering correctly, not merely that the match happened a moment before a crash.
